attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured login-session limits of 8192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified with pam_limits-backed login sessions. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a deferred-ack reboot, confirmed the node went down and came back with a new boot_id, and re-verified the account and limits persisted after restart.
